faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the OAV Begunia Support Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the OAV Begunia Support Staff positions is 21 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Support Staff posts?
faq.answer: A total of 29 vacancies are available for various Support Staff positions, including Warden, Head Cook, Assistant Cook, and Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, at Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Begunia.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Warden post?
faq.answer: For the Warden post, candidates must possess a B.A or B.Sc. degree from any recognized University. This is a key requirement for eligibility for this specific role.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper post is between 21 to 32 years. Applicants must fall within this age bracket to be considered for this role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Head Cook position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Head Cook position is Rs. 9,000/- per month. This is the remuneration that will be provided to the selected candidates for this role.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for the OAV Begunia Support Staff recruitment. Both General/OBC and SC/ST candidates are exempt from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection criteria for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts includes Document Verification, followed by an Interview. For cooking-related roles, a Practical Cooking Test may also be conducted.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the OAV Begunia Support Staff jobs?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address specified in the official notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The Support Staff positions at Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Begunia are contractual in nature. This means the employment is for a fixed term as per the terms of the contract.
